svg.title: Personal AI OS — the adversary pre-build gate
svg.desc: The adversary capability attacks a plan before the build spends the money. It runs on demand ("red-team this") or as build-extension's gate on High-tier builds, before anything is created. The pass sets a hostile frame, steelmans the plan first, then runs five separate reads — load-bearing assumptions with how we would know they are false, failure modes the plan does not name, the cheaper version a skeptic would build, scope traps and hidden dependencies, and the plan-killer named singly. Every finding cites the line it attacks and states its falsifier, and the report must name at least one thing the plan gets right. The verdict is proceed, proceed-with-amendments, or redesign; it advises and never blocks, the report is filed as working material with the plan, and a skipped gate is recorded as skipped-with-owner-OK, never silently. Two evals keep it honest: a seeded-flaw fixture and a retrodiction against a real spec with a known correction.
svg.text: adversary — attack the plan before the build spends the money

svg.text: It tests soundness, never demand — and two evals (seeded flaw, retrodiction) keep the pass falsifiable instead of theatrical.
